subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Mixer @ 25 Lusk - May 15
text:
Hey [NAME],

Long time no speak, hope all's well! Wanted to reach out as [SENDER]'s hosting
an intimate networking event for customers & AI leaders in the Bay Area -
we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can make it!

We've booked a private lounge at 25 Lusk in SF on Thursday, May 15th,
6:30-9:30 pm, capping attendance to ~30 people (open bar + food included).

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Nauto, Netradyne, Seeing Machines
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I saw the [COMPANY]'s recent product releases w/ [COMPANY]-FS10 & thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Nauto, Netradyne, Seeing Machines, Woven by Toyota, Nexar, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts, and road event detection using dashcams. 

We're also working w/ a few other Israeli teams like Pixellot, so keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Working with Viz.ai and Optellum | [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I lead the Medical AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding), actually working with a few of Lung AI-assisted Diagnostic peers (Optellum, Viz.ai etc) to speed up their annotation process and improve model accuracy through precise segmentation of DICOM/NIFTII/CT data (e.g. thresholding brush, tracking) built with traceability in mind. My team has been following Vida for a while, keen to trade notes on what I've been seeing in the Medical Imaging AI space & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next?

subject: Encord & AeroVironment
text:

AeroVironment came up in a conversation with Allen Control Systems at our
Physical AI event in SF last week, so I wanted to reach out. I'm in SF for
the next two weeks before heading back to London, would you be open to a
quick chat while I'm here?

expansion into new use cases - particularly focused on agentic workflows to
automate their annotation pipeline as their requirements grow in complexity

evaluation in one platform.

afternoon PT, but happy to work around your schedule.

I lead a Frontier Labs team here at Encord - we're working closely with a few of your peers to help them iterate faster on foundation model training and evaluation-especially in multimodal and GenAI contexts.

I've been following Mistral's progress with Small 3.1, OCR, and your broader push into multimodal capabilities and would be keen to get your feedback on what we're building here-particularly around multimodal data labeling (text, video/image, docs, etc), dimensionality reduction for visualization, or RLHF-style pipelines using Likert-based human feedback.

Would you be open to a quick 20-min conversation in the next week or two? Wednesdays or Thursdays tend to be easiest on my side.

subject: Working with Viz.ai and Optellum | [SENDER] @ Encord
text:
Hi [NAME]​,

I lead the Medical AI team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding), actually working with a few of Lung AI-assisted Diagnostic peers (Optellum, Viz.ai etc) to speed up their annotation process and improve model accuracy through precise segmentation of DICOM/NIFTII/CT data (e.g. thresholding brush, tracking) built with traceability in mind. My team has been following Vida for a while, keen to trade notes on what I've been seeing in the Medical Imaging AI space & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next?

subject: CV/ML Leaders Mixer - May 15 - 25 Lusk SF
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your leadership on AI/ML products - thought I'd
put our upcoming event with other ML leaders in the Bay Area on your radar.
Our Co-founder & Head of US is hosting a small social mixer on the evening
of May 15th -- we'd love for you to join!

We've booked a private lounge at 25 Lusk from 6:30-9:30pm (catered + open
bar) for 30 industry innovators. Attendance includes CxOs and technical
leaders from Motive, Lucid Motor, Skydio, Archetype AI, etc.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details!
